name: current-staircase
description: Stability-by-current visual test: 1.5 A punch through the L(f) band, then 5 s holds at 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.8 / 1.2 / 1.5 A ASCENDING (down-steps at the voltage ceiling are the known estimator killer, up-steps are safe). Watch the rotor: smooth at the low steps, the 1.5 A leg shows the mid-speed limit cycle.
